#!/bin/bash
REPO=/bench/repo
TMPDIR=$(mktemp -d)
DECLS="$TMPDIR/decls.txt"
ALLGO="$TMPDIR/allgo.txt"
find "$REPO" -name "*.go" > "$ALLGO"

# Extract declarations from internal/ non-test files
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [[ "$f" == *_test.go ]] && continue
  [[ "$f" != *"/internal/"* ]] && continue
  pkg=$(grep -m1 '^package ' "$f" | awk '{print $2}')
  line_num=0
  while IFS= read -r line; do
    ((line_num++))
    if [[ "$line" =~ ^func[[:space:]]+\(([^)]+)\)[[:space:]]+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)[[:space:]]*\( ]]; then
      recv="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
      name="${BASH_REMATCH[2]}"
      recv_type=""
      [[ "$recv" =~ \*?([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*) ]] && recv_type="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
      echo "METHOD|$name|$recv_type|$pkg|$f|$line_num"
    elif [[ "$line" =~ ^func[[:space:]]+([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)[[:space:]]*\( ]]; then
      name="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
      echo "FUNC|$name||$pkg|$f|$line_num"
    fi
  done < "$f"
done < "$ALLGO" > "$DECLS"

echo "Total declarations: $(wc -l < "$DECLS")"

# For top candidate screening, first grep common util names
for candidate in GenUUID ValidateEmail HasPrefixes RandomString ConvertStringToInt32; do
  c=$(grep -r --include="*.go" -E "[^a-zA-Z_]${candidate}[[:space:]]*\(" "$REPO" 2>/dev/null | grep -v "^func " | grep -v "_test.go:" | wc -l)
  echo "Quick: $candidate -> $c"
done

# Count for each decl (this will take a while - optimize by batching)
RESULTS="$TMPDIR/results.txt"
> "$RESULTS"

while IFS='|' read -r kind name recv_type pkg file decl_line; do
  count=0
  callers_file="$TMPDIR/callers_${kind}_${name}.txt"
  > "$callers_file"
  
  if [[ "$kind" == "METHOD" ]]; then
    pattern="\\.${name}[[:space:]]*\\("
  else
    pattern="[^a-zA-Z_]${name}[[:space:]]*\\(|\\.${name}[[:space:]]*\\("
  fi
  
  while IFS= read -r gfile; do
    # skip declaration line in declaring file
    grep -n -E "$pattern" "$gfile" 2>/dev/null | while IFS=: read -r ln rest; do
      if [[ "$gfile" == "$file" && "$ln" == "$decl_line" ]]; then continue; fi

  # distinct files as proxy for callers (fast)
  dfiles=$(cut -d: -f1 "$callers_file" 2>/dev/null | sort -u | wc -l)
  echo "$count|$dfiles|$kind|$name|$recv_type|$pkg|$file|$decl_line" >> "$RESULTS"
done < "$DECLS"

sort -t'|' -k1,1nr -k2,2nr "$RESULTS" | head -40

echo "---"
echo "Analysis temp: $TMPDIR"

BEGIN {
    repo = "/bench/repo"

# This script processes pre-generated data
AWKEOF

# Simpler approach: extract decls, then for each top candidate do detailed grep
# First extract all declarations
find /bench/repo/internal -name "*.go" ! -name "*_test.go" -print0 | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  pkg=$(grep -m1 '^package ' "$f" | awk '{print $2}')
  awk -v pkg="$pkg" -v file="$f" '
    /^func / {
      line = NR
      if (match($0, /^func \([^)]+\) ([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\(/, a)) {
        recv = $0
        sub(/^func \(/, "", recv)
        sub(/\).*/, "", recv)
        rt = recv
        sub(/^[^*]*\*/, "", rt)
        sub(/ .*/, "", rt)
        print "METHOD|" a[1] "|" rt "|" pkg "|" file "|" line
      } else if (match($0, /^func ([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)\(/, a)) {
        print "FUNC|" a[1] "||" pkg "|" file "|" line
      }
    }
  ' "$f"
done > /tmp/decls.txt

echo "Declarations: $(wc -l < /tmp/decls.txt)"

# Fast count function
count_calls() {
  local kind="$1" name="$2" file="$3" decl_line="$4"

#!/bin/bash

# Build import map: for each file, which local name maps to which internal import path
build_imports() {
  find "$REPO" -name "*.go" | while read -r f; do
    # Extract imports block - simplified
    awk '
      /^import \(/ { inimport=1; next }
      inimport && /^\)/ { inimport=0; next }
      inimport {
        line=$0
        gsub(/"/, "", line)
        gsub(/[()]/, "", line)
        gsub(/^[ \t]+/, "", line)
        gsub(/[ \t]+$/, "", line)
        if (line ~ /internal\//) {
          alias=""
          path=""
          n=split(line, parts, " ")
          if (n==1) { path=parts[1]; alias=parts[1]; sub(/.*\//, "", alias) }
          else { alias=parts[1]; path=parts[2] }
          print FILENAME "|" alias "|" path
        }
      }
      /^import "/ {
        line=$0
        gsub(/"/, "", line)
        sub(/^import /, "", line)

  done
}

while IFS='|' read -r kind name recv pkg file dline; do

  relpath="${file#/bench/repo/}"

  # same package, non-test
  dir=$(dirname "$file")
  for gfile in "$dir"/*.go; do
    [[ "$gfile" == *_test.go ]] && continue
    [ -f "$gfile" ] || continue
    gpkg=$(grep -m1 '^package ' "$gfile" | awk '{print $2}')
    [ "$gpkg" != "$pkg" ] && continue
    if [ "$kind" = "METHOD" ]; then
      grep -n "\\.${name}[[:space:]]*(" "$gfile" 2>/dev/null | while IFS=: read -r ln rest; do
        [ "$gfile" = "$file" ] && [ "$ln" = "$dline" ] && continue
        orig=$(sed -n "${ln}p" "$gfile"); echo "$orig" | grep -q '^func ' && continue
        echo "$gfile:$ln"
      done >> /tmp/hits_$$.txt
    else
      grep -n "[^a-zA-Z_]${name}[[:space:]]*(" "$gfile" 2>/dev/null | while IFS=: read -r ln rest; do
        [ "$gfile" = "$file" ] && [ "$ln" = "$dline" ] && continue
        orig=$(sed -n "${ln}p" "$gfile"); echo "$orig" | grep -q '^func ' && continue
        echo "$gfile:$ln"
      done >> /tmp/hits_$$.txt
    fi
  done
  
  # cross-package non-test
  grep "|${importpath}$" /tmp/imports.txt 2>/dev/null | while IFS='|' read -r gfile alias ipath; do
    [[ "$gfile" == *_test.go ]] && continue
    if [ "$kind" = "METHOD" ]; then
      grep -n "\\.${name}[[:space:]]*(" "$gfile" 2>/dev/null | while IFS=: read -r ln rest; do
        orig=$(sed -n "${ln}p" "$gfile"); echo "$orig" | grep -q '^func ' && continue
        echo "$gfile:$ln"
      done
    else
      grep -n "${alias}\.${name}[[:space:]]*(" "$gfile" 2>/dev/null | while IFS=: read -r ln rest; do
        orig=$(sed -n "${ln}p" "$gfile"); echo "$orig" | grep -q '^func ' && continue
        echo "$gfile:$ln"
      done
    fi
  done >> /tmp/hits_$$.txt 2>/dev/null
  
  count=$(wc -l < /tmp/hits_$$.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
  dfiles=$(cut -d: -f1 /tmp/hits_$$.txt 2>/dev/null | sort -u | wc -l)
  echo -e "${count}\t${dfiles}\t${kind}\t${name}\t${recv}\t${file}:${dline}" >> /tmp/prod_results.txt
  rm -f /tmp/hits_$$.txt
done < /tmp/decls.txt

// CompileToStatement compiles and renders the filter in a single step.
func (e *Engine) CompileToStatement(ctx context.Context, filter string, opts RenderOptions) (Statement, error) {
	program, err := e.Compile(ctx, filter)
	if err != nil {
		return Statement{}, err
	}
	return program.Render(opts)
}
